svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural
svg.desc: 140 approved hand-painted covers by 140 people. Each painting includes its original birthday wish in its description.
svg.metadata: Snapshot 8293ad0adab0fd5a. Saved 2026-11-10T14:24:38.001Z. Original vector strokes; no external assets.

g.title: Fyy
g.desc: Trap, even though we don't know each other that well, I can tell that you're such a kind and thoughtful person. Thank you for always being around and for continuously helping Arcade, especially Fear and Esthell. Your time, effort, and willingness to help never go unnoticed, and I'm sure your presence means more than you realise. for all the good things you've done. May Allah protect your heart, grant you good health, and fill your days with barakah. I hope life treats you gently, and may you always be surrounded by people who appreciate your kindness as much as you deserve. جزاكِ اللهُ خيرًا

g.title: CocoLoco0
g.desc: Jazzzzz! Here's to another year of you becoming the wise old soul that you've always been! Fr tho, I've always thought you're much wiser beyond your years, having some perspective that you don't usually find at your age, and Ive always admired that. And even though we don't talk as much these days, I'm really glad we've managed to stay in touch, even if it's just occasionally. I am really so grateful to have you as a friend, Jazz. You truly deserve all the love and happiness in this world and then some! I'll always be rooting for you :)

g.title: manan1322
g.desc: Trap wishing you a very happy birthday. Enjoy your day and trap good moments and good luck on your birthday in life and let go of all bad experiences in life🔥

g.title: hiffuu
g.desc: Happy birthday cutie 💞 May your life always be free from hurdles and you get everything you want ❣️ Stay happy and healthy always 🫶

g.title: Dixie
g.desc: Happy birthday Trap aka ISirena! Your generosity never goes unnoticed. From sacrificing to sponsor giveaways to keeping the GC peaceful, you bring happiness to people in your own way. May all the kindness you spread return to you tenfold. Wishing you endless happiness, success, and barakah. Stay blessed!

g.title: _ZUKO__
g.desc: Finally you getting more big more mature more old more beautiful more savage... Hope your upcoming days of life become luxurious ... You get all the happiness you deserve and God bless you forever 🖤🤍

g.title: Marshmallw
g.desc: 🎂 Happy birthday TRAP 🎂 Wishing you a beautiful day and a year ahead full of happy moments

g.title: KlTE
g.desc: Trap you are very sweet and kind You deserve all the happiness, love, and magic this world has to offer. Keep shining, keep smiling, and never let that beautiful spark in you fade. May your life always be filled with little moments that make your heart happy. Stay precious, birthday girl! 🎀💕✨

g.title: zva
g.desc: Happy birthday, Trap! 🥹💗 Hope your day is filled with happiness, laughter, and beautiful memories. Stay the same wonderful person you are, keep smiling, and may this year bring you everything your heart wishes for. 🎂✨

g.title: yashtachi
g.desc: Happy Birthday Trap aka notsiren aka jazz 🎂 Still remember how we met last year in the weekly ocho haha . Stay a happy, healthy and a wealthy year ahead along with my bro wytie 💕 And when we going to continue alice in the borderland jajaja
